features: Cable Length 【1.6FT/50CM/ 19.68 Inch】 【Micro B to USB C Hard Drive Cable】 This USB C to Micro B cable connects a computer/PC/laptop with a USB Type C port to an External Hard Drive, Smartphone or Tablet for data & charging. NOTE: This is USB C to Micro USB B Cable. It does NOT fit regular USB-A port or Micro USB 2.0. It does NOT fit with iPhone.

🚀【UP to 10Gbps Transfer Rate】 The USB 3.1 C to USB Micro B cord supports ultra-fast data transfer rate up to 10Gbps for transferring files from Solid State Drives (SSD) (Please Note: when working with the traditional hard drives the data speed is about 5Gbps!!! ) or sync data from your smartphone, which is 20X faster than USB 2.0 version, 2X faster than USB 3.0 version.

【Micro B Compatibility List】 Micro USB B male is Target (Device) side, compatible with USB 3.1 Micro-B port devices such as Samsung Galaxy S5, Galaxy Note 3, Galaxy Note Pro 12.2, and Portable USB 3.1 External Hard Drives.

♻️ Universal Compatibility: Whether you're transferring files or syncing data, our external hard drive cable delivers lightning-fast speeds and exceptional performance. Plus, the usb c to micro b cable works seamlessly with a wide range of devices, including external hard drives, cameras, hard drive enclosures, galaxy phones, tablets, laptops, and more.

💪【USB C Compatibility List】: USB-C (USB Type C) is the Host side, compatible with MacBook Pro (2016~2020), iMac 2017, iMac Pro, MacBook Air (2018~2020), iPad Pro (11inch, 12.9inch), Dell XPS 13 / 15, Google Chromebook Pixel, HP Pavilion X2, Yoga 910, OnePlus 6 6T 5 5T 3, Galaxy S22/ S20/ S10/ S9/ S8/ Note20/ Note10/ Note9/ Note8 and other Host based devices with USB Type C port

💪【Micro B Compatibility List】: Micro USB B male is Target (Device) side, compatible with USB 3.1 Micro-B port devices such as Samsung Galaxy S5, Galaxy Note 3, Galaxy Note Pro 12.2, Nikon D800/D800E, Canon EOS 5DS/5DSR/5D4 camera and Portable USB 3.1 External Hard Drives including Toshiba Canvio, Seagate FreeAgent, Western Digital (WD) My Passport, LaCie, Elements hard drives
【Compatible】: Support USB3.0 (5Gbps), compatible with USB2.0 (480Mbps) and USB1.1 (12Mbps) specifications, support Windows2000/2003/XP/Vista/WIN7SP1, etc.
【High-speed data transmission】: USB C to Micro B cable supports high-speed data synchronous transmission, the transmission speed is up to 5Gbps
【MicroB to USB C cable】: Connect a computer/PC/laptop with a USB C port to an external hard drive, smart phone or tablet for data transfer
